entries.name: Getting started from scratch with Aseprite
Pixel logic
entries.description: Pixel Logic is an in-depth pixel art tutorial book.

entries.name: Make Your Own Pixel Art
entries.description: Walks you step-by-step through the available tools, pixel art techniques, the importance of shapes, colors, shading, and how to turn your art into animation.

entries.name: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island
entries.description: Play as Yoshi carrying Baby Mario, platforming through a dangerous world. The painted feel and soft pastel colors create an hearth-warming handmade style that breathes the charm of a children’s book.

entries.name: FEZ
entries.description: Explore a 2D retrofuturistic world by rotating in the third dimension. The minimalistic style, bright vibrant colors and dynamic lighting bring the 16-bit era into the future.

entries.name: Superbrothers: Sword & Sworcery EP
entries.description: Laid back adventure in a bronze age mountain wilderness. Dreamy soft colors in a living world affected by moon phases.

entries.name: Undertale
entries.description: A story-driven RPG where you explore a world of monsters. Turn-based combat. Retro 16-bit visuals, a rich narrative, and multiple endings based on your choices.

entries.name: Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove
entries.description: Classic action adventure with an 8-bit retro aesthetic, taking the looks of a modern NES game.

entries.name: Hyper Light Drifter
entries.description: Top-down action in a sci-fi world that radiates light and warmth. Using a colorful palette and kaleidoscopic neon yet setting a grim ambiance.

entries.name: Owlboy
entries.description: Explore a detailed steampunk world in the clouds. With it's range of endearing animations and expressions the world and it's characters come to life.

entries.name: Stardew Valley
entries.description: Manage a farm from a top-down perspective and engage with a charming and cheerful world in 16-bit.

entries.name: Starbound
entries.description: Travel across vibrant, colorful and expansive galaxies, including creative dynamic animations.

entries.name: Void Golf
entries.description: Shoot giant pieces of space rock into black holes, using gravitational fields, physics-defying walls and wormholes in a minimalist top-down view.

entries.name: Minit
entries.description: With a minimalistic design (only two colors palette). Minit is an adventure where each exploration journey is limited to 60 seconds.

entries.name: Sean Browning - Pixel Art Animation Reel 2018
entries.description: A collection of Sean Browning's pixel animations, ranging from simple scenes to recreations of popular shows like Steven's Universe and RWBY.

entries.name: Pixel Paul - An Interview with Pixel Artist and Animator Paul Veer
entries.description: Paul Veer, a professional pixel artist with work on games such as Super Crate Box, shares his interest in pixel art as well as his workflow and style breakdown.

entries.name: MortMort channel
entries.description: Creative videos & streams including tips, discussions and tutorials.

entries.name: Lospec palette list
entries.description: Collection of color palettes for pixel art with examples and artist information.

entries.name: eBoy
entries.description: German, pixel art group founded in 1997 by Kai Vermehr, Steffen Sauerteig and Svend Smital. They are regarded as the “Godfathers of Pixel Art”.

entries.name: Paul Robertson
entries.description: Australian, creating cute, sometimes cosmic and psychedelic, and sometimes weird nightmarish pixel art.

entries.name: Syosa
entries.description: Japanese, girlish style using bright and organic color palettes creating cute humans and animals.

entries.name: Thomas Feichtmeir
entries.description: Australian, dark and mature: fan of knights, dinosaurs, pirates, epic beasts, anatomy and history as well as everything twisted and weird.

entries.name: Toyoi Yuuta
entries.description: Australian, capturing small animated scenes of everyday life in unsaturated colors.

entries.name: Slynyrd
entries.description: American, game designer with tons of material, game specific knowledge and mini-tutorials.

entries.name: Aseprite
entries.description: Paid and source-available, works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Awesome UI with a lot of nifty tools to ease pixel art creation.

entries.name: Pixen
entries.description: Paid, works on macOS and iOS. Superb OS integration, create pixel art on a tablet using pressure-sensitive drawing.

entries.name: Pro Motion
entries.description: Paid with trial, works on Windows. Advanced features tailored to creating pixel art for games.

entries.name: GIMP
entries.description: Open source and free, works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Not specifically for creating pixel art but is more than capable to do so.

entries.name: PixelCraft
entries.description: Open source and free, works in the browser. Easy to try out in the browser and as a PWA offline.

entries.name: rx
entries.description: Open source and free, works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Minimalist and keyboard driven with animation support.

entries.name: Wobblepaint
entries.description: Pico8 editor that give life to pixel art with a little wobble.

entries.name: Pixelrepo
entries.description: Free and works in the browser. Import files and palettes, save locally. Minimalist, easy to use, and perfect for quick pixel art editing.

entries.name: Draw!
entries.description: Editor for creating tiny GIF animations. Open source and free, works in the browser.

entries.name: Broider
entries.description: Make 9-patch borders, export as CSS.

entries.name: pixeldudesmaker
entries.description: Small character generator, including basic animation.

entries.name: PixelArtChallenge
entries.description: Pixel art recreation challenges, practice solo or compete in real-time 1v1 matches.

entries.name: Palette Extractor
entries.description: Free and works in the browser. Pull a sprite's exact palette, export .gpl, Lospec .hex, CSS or JSON.
